cause_quote: The new task workspace used `const taskId = deriveGitHubPublicationTaskId(origin, params.idempotencyKey);`, so a fresh invocation selected a different publication task.
user_saw: Publishing the same local checkout again after a follow-up commit opened a duplicate GitHub pull request.
summary: The fix reuses one publication task per conversation and canonical checkout and synchronizes follow-up commits to its existing PR branch while preserving exact retries.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent’s integration tests, which show that the old flow adopted a managed worktree and rejected a second publish from the original source path. PR #196168 introduced the separate publication task and included the invocation key in the task hash, so fresh calls from the same source checkout created separate PRs from the start.
